paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.79% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+4.32%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-1.51%). Brent crude changed -2.56% to 95.77. Gold changed -5.64% to 3,881.7. Bitcoin changed -5.78% to 71,371.6094. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.103%, a relative move of +5.50%. Among the firms tracked, Franklin Templeton (+11.33%) and Lazard (+6.07%) moved the most.
